question: What quantity of iron oxide was discovered on Elorza crater?
sparql:
PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?properties_values, ?property_description
WHERE {
  ?papers rdf:type orkgc:Paper.
  ?papers rdfs:label ?papers_labels.
  FILTER(REGEX(?papers_labels, "Elorza crater", "i"))
  ?papers orkgp:P31 ?contrib.
  ?contrib ?properties ?properties_values.
  ?properties rdfs:label ?properties_labels.
  FILTER(REGEX(?properties_labels, "FeO"))
  ?properties orkgp:description ?property_description.
}

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?code
WHERE {
  ?model    a            orkgc:Model;
            rdfs:label    ?model_lbl.
  FILTER (str(?model_lbl) = "ImageNet + iNat on WS-DAN")
  ?benchmark      orkgp:HAS_DATASET        ?dataset.
  ?cont           orkgp:HAS_BENCHMARK      ?benchmark.
  ?cont           orkgp:HAS_MODEL          ?model;
                  orkgp:HAS_SOURCE_CODE    ?code.
}

question: What models are being evaluated on the seel.cse.lsu.edu/data/re17.zip  dataset?
sparql:
PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?model ?model_lbl
WHERE {
  ?dataset       a                orkgc:Dataset;
                  rdfs:label       ?dataset_lbl.
  FILTER (str(?dataset_lbl) = "seel.cse.lsu.edu/data/re17.zip ")
  ?benchmark      orkgp:HAS_DATASET       ?dataset;
                  orkgp:HAS_EVALUATION    ?eval.
  ?paper         orkgp:HAS_BENCHMARK      ?benchmark.
  OPTIONAL {?paper      orkgp:HAS_MODEL          ?model.
            ?model      rdfs:label               ?model_lbl.}
}

question: What are the titles and IDs of research papers that include a benchmark for the NLP-TDMS dataset?
sparql:
PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paper_lbl
WHERE {
  ?dataset        a                orkgc:Dataset;
                  rdfs:label       ?dataset_lbl.
  FILTER (str(?dataset_lbl) = "NLP-TDMS")
  ?benchmark      orkgp:HAS_DATASET       ?dataset.
  ?cont          orkgp:HAS_BENCHMARK      ?benchmark.
  ?paper         orkgp:P31                ?cont;
                 rdfs:label               ?paper_lbl.
}

question: Can you list the metrics used to evaluate models on the DocRED (Human-annotated) dataset?
Which sectors are modeled as energy sectors and how often?
sparql:
PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?label COUNT(?label)
WHERE {
  ?sector rdfs:label ?label;
          a ?class.
  ?class owl:equivalentClass <http://openenergy-platform.org/ontology/oeo/OEO_00000367>.
  [
    orkgp:P37668 ?sector
  ].
}
